title: Cardboard desk organizer
summary: Corrugated cardboard cut into slotted walls makes a sturdy tray with compartments for pens, notes and a phone.
summary_ar: كرتون مضلّع مقطّع إلى جدران متداخلة يصنع صينية متينة بأقسام للأقلام والأوراق والهاتف.
result: a neat brown corrugated cardboard desk tray with tall and short compartments holding pens, sticky notes and a phone
extra_materials: a cutting mat or thick board
kraft paper or fabric to cover (optional)
steps_outline: Flatten the box and draw the base and wall pieces with a ruler
Cut the pieces on a board with the craft knife using several light passes
Cut matching half-depth slots so the dividers lock together
Glue the walls to the base and hold them with masking tape while the glue sets
Cover the edges with tape or paper for a clean finish
safety: Wear work gloves, cut away from your body and keep your other hand behind the blade

title: Woven newspaper basket
summary: Newspaper rolled into thin tubes and woven around a cardboard base makes a light, surprisingly strong basket.
summary_ar: جرائد ملفوفة في أنابيب رفيعة ومنسوجة حول قاعدة كرتونية تصنع سلة خفيفة وقوية على نحو مدهش.
result: a round woven basket made of tightly rolled newspaper tubes, grey print visible, with a neat folded rim
extra_materials: a cardboard circle for the base
steps_outline: Cut newspaper sheets into strips about 8 cm wide
Roll each strip tightly around a skewer at an angle and glue the end
Glue an odd number of tubes around the cardboard base as spokes
Weave tubes in and out of the spokes, joining new tubes by pushing one end into another
Fold the spoke ends into the weave at the top and brush the basket with diluted glue
safety: Decorative and storage use only, not for food

title: Newspaper seedling pots
summary: Newspaper folded around a jar makes biodegradable pots you plant straight into the ground.
summary_ar: جرائد مطوية حول برطمان تصنع أصصًا قابلة للتحلل تُزرع في الأرض مباشرة.
result: a tray of small cylindrical pots folded from newspaper, filled with soil and tiny green seedlings
extra_materials: a small jar or can to shape the pots
steps_outline: Cut a newspaper page into strips 10 cm wide
Roll a strip around a jar, leaving 4 cm hanging past the bottom
Fold the overhang in to form a base and press it flat on the table
Slide the jar out, fill the pot with soil and sow a seed
Plant the whole pot in the ground when the seedling is ready
safety: Use plain newsprint, not glossy or coated pages

title: Cardboard cat hideout
summary: A box with a round door and window becomes a cosy hideout cats love to nap and play in.
summary_ar: صندوق بباب دائري ونافذة يصبح مخبأً دافئًا تحب القطط النوم واللعب فيه.
result: a brown cardboard box shaped like a small house with a pointed roof, a round door and a small window, an old folded towel inside
extra_materials: an old towel or T-shirt for bedding
steps_outline: Remove all staples and plastic tape from the box
Draw a 20 cm round door and a small window
Cut them out with the craft knife on a board
Fold two flaps up into a roof and tape them together from inside
Add an old towel as a bed
safety: Wear work gloves while cutting and cut away from your body
Remove every staple and use only paper tape so the pet cannot chew plastic or metal

title: Coiled magazine bowl
summary: Magazine strips folded, coiled and pushed into shape become a colorful decorative bowl for keys or jewellery.
summary_ar: شرائط المجلات المطوية والملفوفة تتشكّل وعاءً ملونًا للزينة أو لحفظ المفاتيح والحلي.
result: a small shallow bowl made of tightly coiled folded magazine strips in bright mixed colors, holding a set of keys
extra_materials: a small bowl to shape it
steps_outline: Cut magazine pages into 4 cm strips along the long side
Fold each strip in half twice lengthwise to make a flat 1 cm band
Coil a band tightly, gluing as you go, and glue on new bands end to end
When the disc is wide enough, press the centre over a bowl to shape it
Coat inside and out with diluted PVA glue and let it dry hard
safety: Decorative use only: keep it away from food and water

title: Newspaper gift bags
summary: Folded and glued newspaper makes crisp gift bags with twine handles, no new wrapping paper needed.
summary_ar: جرائد مطوية وملصوقة تصنع أكياس هدايا أنيقة بمقابض من الخيط دون الحاجة إلى ورق تغليف جديد.
result: a small crisp gift bag folded from black-and-white newspaper with a flat base and natural twine handles
extra_materials: a book or box to fold around
a hole punch or pencil to make handle holes
steps_outline: Fold a double sheet of newspaper around a book and glue the side seam
Fold and glue the bottom like wrapping a present
Slide the book out and crease the sides inwards
Fold the top edge over for strength and punch two holes on each side
Knot twine through the holes as handles
safety: Keep glue sticks and scissors away from young children

title: Cardboard laptop stand
summary: Two layered cardboard side panels and a slotted crossbar lift a laptop to a healthier screen height.
summary_ar: لوحان جانبيان من طبقات الكرتون وعارضة متداخلة يرفعان الحاسوب إلى ارتفاع صحي للشاشة.
result: a sturdy flat-pack laptop stand made of layered brown corrugated cardboard, two angled side panels joined by a slotted crossbar, holding a laptop
extra_materials: heavy books to press the layers
steps_outline: Measure your laptop and draw two angled side panels about 25 cm tall
Cut three copies of each panel and glue them in stacks with the corrugation crossing
Press the stacks under books until the glue sets
Cut a crossbar and matching slots so the pieces lock together
Test the fit and add a small lip at the front so the laptop cannot slide
safety: Wear work gloves, use a board under the cut and change to a fresh blade when it drags

title: Egg-carton small-parts organizer
title_ar: منظّم قطع صغيرة من علبة البيض
summary: A painted egg carton sorts earrings, buttons, screws or seeds into twelve little cups.
summary_ar: علبة بيض مطلية تفرز الأقراط أو الأزرار أو البراغي أو البذور في اثني عشر تجويفًا صغيرًا.
result: an open cardboard egg carton painted in soft pastel colors, each cup holding buttons, beads or earrings
steps_outline: Check the carton is clean and dry and trim off any torn flaps
Paint the inside cups, then the outside, in thin coats
Let it dry with the lid open
Sort small parts into the cups and label the lid
safety: Wear gloves or old clothes when painting and cover the table

title: Cardboard-tube cable tidy
summary: Cardboard tubes standing in a shoebox keep chargers and cables coiled, labelled and untangled.
summary_ar: أنابيب كرتونية قائمة داخل علبة أحذية تبقي الشواحن والأسلاك ملفوفة ومرتبة ومعلّمة.
result: a shoebox packed with upright cardboard tubes, each holding a neatly coiled cable with a small hand-written label
steps_outline: Trim the tubes to the height of the box
Stand them in the box side by side
Coil each cable loosely and slide it into a tube
Label each tube with masking tape and a pencil
safety: Coil cables loosely: tight bends damage the wires inside
